description: Header file for FreeType support for .Z compressed files, implementing LZW decompression logic and state management.

classes.name: FT_LzwStateRec
classes.description: Structure representing the state of the LZW decompression process, including phase, buffer, code parameters, and stream info.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_init
methods.description: Initializes the LZW state with a source stream.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_done
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the LZW state.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_reset
methods.description: Resets the LZW decompression state to initial conditions.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_io
methods.description: Performs input/output operations for LZW decompression, reading from the source stream into a buffer.
